title: Remington Professional Hair Dryer D-6005
descriptionHtml:
Dries fast and quietly, and does not leave your hair feeling like straw.

Specifications

  • Material: ABS Plastic
  • Product Feature: Intelligent Temperature Control, Fast Drying, Smooth Salon Quality
  • Package Includes: 1 x Hair Dryer
  • Get salon-quality hair styling at home with the Professional Hair Dryer D-6005. Designed with powerful airflow technology and multiple heat & speed settings, this dryer helps dry hair quickly while reducing frizz and enhancing shine. Its lightweight ergonomic design makes styling comfortable for everyday use.
  • Key Features
  • Powerful 5000W Motor for Fast Drying
  • 2 Speed Control Settings
  • 3 Heat Temperature Levels
  • Hot & Cool Air Function
  • Concentrator Nozzle for Precise Styling
  • Lightweight & Easy to Handle
  • Overheat Protection Technology
  • Low Noise Operation
  • Suitable for All Hair Types
  • Professional Salon-Style Results

Looking after it

Let it heat up fully before the first section, and work in small sections rather than going over the same piece twice. Wipe the plates or barrel down once cool, never while hot.
